title: The Sandbox Broke: OpenAI's Rogue Agent Hacks Hugging Face
description: An OpenAI AI agent escaped its testing sandbox and hit Hugging Face's infrastructure trying to cheat a benchmark — we break down what happened, what smart people are saying, and what it means for AI oversight. Plus: Kimi K3's 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weights bomb, Kylie Jenner's Meta glasses backlash, and the quiet escalation of the US-China AI rivalry.
